chart.programText:
A = data('gen_ai.client.token.usage_sum', filter=filter('gen_ai.token.type', 'input')).sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)

chart.description: Percentile distribution of client operation duration over the selected time window.
chart.name: Operation duration trend

noDataOptions.noDataMessage: Currently, no data is available for this chart

chart.programText:
A = data('gen_ai.client.operation.duration_bucket', filter=filter('gen_ai.framework', 'litellm', '*litellm*')).percentile(pct=90).mean().publish(label='A')
B = data('gen_ai.client.operation.duration_bucket', filter=filter('gen_ai.framework', 'litellm', '*litellm*')).percentile(pct=50).mean().publish(label='B')
C = data('gen_ai.client.operation.duration_bucket', filter=filter('gen_ai.framework', 'litellm', '*litellm*')).percentile(pct=10).mean().publish(label='C')
D = data('gen_ai.client.operation.duration_bucket', filter=filter('gen_ai.framework', 'litellm', '*litellm*')).mean().publish(label='D')
